newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar bounces off lows ahead of close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar bounces off lows ahead of close.

text.p: London's August white sugar contract bounced off the day's lows in late trading on Wednesday to finish just below Tuesday's close.
The August contract dominated overall market volume and ended $0.50 easier at $317.90. October, meanwhile, was up $0.50 at $308.00.
Prices had tracked the downward correction on the New York raws market in the early afternoon, dropping to a low of $316.60, traders said.
But ahead of the close August moved back to touch Tuesday's high of $318.50 before settling just lower.
"It's been moving sideways all day. There hasn't been anything spectacular," a trader said.
Total volume came in at 3,114 lots.
In Paris August also came off lows to settle $0.20 firmer at $317.80, while October was untraded.
